title: A €20,000 Electric Car? Here's the Catch #Shorts
description:
What would you give up for an electric car at around €20,000? Volkswagen says its planned ID. EVERY1, due in 2027, is aiming for that price, with at least 250 km of WLTP range, a 70 kW motor and a 130 km/h top speed. The battery hasn't been confirmed, and the price and specs are VW targets that could still change, but a real entry-level EV could make going electric easier for many more people.
Would you buy it? Tell us in the comments, and subscribe for more hopeful science and future tech with Future on a Budget.
Sources: electrive (5 Mar 2025); Electrek (22 Oct 2026)
